added.statement: The managed J-Code model surface shall expose native Kimi K3 and native MiniMax M3 routes alongside explicit CentralCloud gateway K3/M3 routes.
acceptance_criteria: swarm list_models reports kimi:k3 through openai-compatible:kimi
swarm list_models reports minimax-direct:MiniMax-M3 through openai-compatible:minimax-direct
swarm list_models retains explicit llm-gateway K3 and MiniMax-M3 routes
the direct MiniMax profile targets https://api.minimax.io/v1 and does not use the built-in minimaxi.com heuristic

ears.response: expose distinct direct Kimi K3, direct MiniMax M3, and llm-gateway fallback routes

breaker.condition: a direct-prefixed K3 or M3 route resolves through llm-gateway, or either fallback family disappears

added.statement: Home Manager shall render provider-specific mode-0600 credential files from SOPS and shall use one launcher and one default J-Code runtime for the daemon, TUI, WebTTY, and CLI.
acceptance_criteria: Kimi receives KIMI_API_KEY through kimi.env
the named MiniMax direct profile receives MINIMAX_API_KEY through minimax-direct.env
llm-gateway receives JCODE_PROVIDER_LLM_GATEWAY_API_KEY through its provider env file
tracked and Nix-store files contain no provider secret values
exactly one jcode serve process remains after activation

ears.system: Managed J-Code launcher and credential renderer
ears.response: render isolated credentials and keep every client on the existing default runtime without a second daemon

breaker.condition: a secret enters the Nix store, a provider reads another provider's key, or a second runtime/daemon appears

added.statement: The global swarm policy and mutable J-Code preferences shall prefer direct K3/M3 routes, allow explicit gateway fallbacks, preserve unrelated settings, and keep failover manual.
acceptance_criteria: the global prompt names direct and gateway route IDs and no longer forbids gateway fallback
the preferences merger updates only managed provider/auth keys and named profiles
unrelated keybindings, display, MCP, hooks, and safety settings survive application
cross_provider_failover remains manual

ears.trigger: the coordinator selects Kimi K3 or MiniMax M3
ears.response: choose the direct route first and use an explicitly named llm-gateway route only as fallback

breaker.condition: preference application deletes unrelated config or the policy allows an implicit/mislabeled fallback

test_plan.description: Catalog-only and swarm route probes reject missing, gateway-mislabeled, or wrong-endpoint direct routes.
Home Manager source tests reject missing SOPS rendering, secret literals, divergent launchers, or alternate runtime directories.
Preference-merger tests prove managed routing keys change while unrelated TOML settings survive; prompt tests prove direct-first explicit fallback wording.
